verdict.rationale: GitCafe is a Git forge, so second-factor authentication with hardware keys or passkeys is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions two-factor authentication, WebAuthn, security keys or passkeys. SSH/GPG keys, personal access tokens and browser-approved CLI sign-in are adjacent authentication features, not a second factor, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a hardware security key or passkey as a second factor
